item.title: A check-in when Apple Health goes quiet
item.summary: Murph can check in privately on iMessage after three days without an Apple Health update, with a reminder to open Murph and check for new data.
item.details: You'll get one check-in per gap, in an existing active conversation. Ask Murph to wait 5–30 days or stop these check-ins; your connection and syncing stay on. A gap alone does not mean your app was closed or your connection broke.
